title: WardenBlade
description: The same as a netherite sword but it can shoot a warden beam doing 5 hearts with a 50 second cooldown
body:
# Warden Blade

Warden Blade adds a powerful custom weapon to Minecraft inspired by the Warden’s sonic attack.

Features:

* Custom Warden Blade texture
* Fires a sonic beam on right click
* Damages players and mobs
* 50 second recharge system
* XP bar cooldown indicator
* Built for Paper 1.21.11

Command:
`/wardenblade`

The plugin also includes an automatic resource pack for the custom sword texture.
